title: sales-partnership-scratch-notes-anjali
content:
Notes / scratchpad for strategic partnership outreach (super rough).

Context:
- Trying to get initial intro + tech eval with Acme Cloud Platform (ACME) and a follow-up pilot convo with Evergreen Health (regional health system).
- Goal: 15-30 min intro call to surface latency/cost pain and propose Redwood Dedicated pilot (4-8 GPUs) + observability + SLAs.

Account: Acme Cloud Platform (AcmeCloud)
- Size: 300 engs, platform org. SRE/Platform lead focused on cost and multi-tenant isolation.
- DM: Jordan Hale (VP Platform) - LinkedIn notes: moved from BigCloud (platform infra) in 2023.
- Champion (internal): unknown - try to find developer advocate or infra lead.
- What they care about: consistent latency across regions, cost predictability for tenant isolation, regulatory logs for enterprise customers.
- Potential value props to call out: Dedicated pools, routing policies by tier/region, KV/prefix cache to reduce 90p latency on repeated requests, cost-aware routing (save 20-40% token spend vs naive host).

Acme pain signals seen in job posts / blog / telemetries:
- Hiring 2x SREs for "inference runtime optimization" -> suggests current infra ops burden.
- Blog post (Apr 2025) about "multi-tenant model isolation" and limits on bursting -> opportunity to propose dedicated capacity + burst.

Quick outbound email (draft)
Subject: A quick idea on predictable LLM inference costs for AcmeCloud
Hi Jordan -

I’m Anjali on the partnerships team at Redwood Inference. We work with platform teams (FastCloud, Retailly) to give them a single inference runtime that makes latency and per-token cost predictable across hosted, reserved, and private deployments.

From what I can tell AcmeCloud is prioritizing tenant isolation and predictable burst capacity - two places we’ve helped similar platform teams reduce spend up to ~30% while hitting latency SLOs. Would you be open to 20 minutes next week to share one concrete pattern that’s worked (dedicated GPU pools + routing policies + KV caching)? Happy to tailor to your region/tenant model.

If useful, I can include a short config sketch for 4-8 GPUs so you can see latency/cost tradeoffs quickly.

Best,
Anjali Rao
partnerships | Redwood Inference

Call agenda (20 min)
- 0-3m quick intros + confirm pain (cost predictability / isolation)
- 3-8m high-level architecture: Dedicated pools, routing, fallback models
- 8-14m example metrics from similar customer (tokens/sec, 90p latency pre/post) + expected cost delta
- 14-18m discuss pilot options (duration, KPIs, data controls)
- 18-20m next steps / decision owner

Objection handling (short bullets)
- "We can build this internally" -> Agree: we can help accelerate + provide a hardened runtime + observability so you don't re-invent ops. Offer a 6-week engagement to validate for less than internal infra dev cost. Reference: JIRA-ACCT-879 (pilot SOW).
- "Security / data residency concerns" -> Private control plane + VPC option + KMS/HSM support. Offer network diagram + SOC2 artifacts. Link to compliance page: CONFLUENCE-PLAT-1234.
- "Costs look high" -> Share unit economics: batching + caching recommendations often reduce per-token CPU/GPU by 20-40%. Offer a small PoC with real traces to show delta. Provide estimate template during call.
- "Model fidelity concerns" -> Redwood Optimize recommendations + rollouts and quick rollback policies; can pin models and run A/B for N prompts.

Prep TODOs (before outreach)
- Pull recent Acme infra blog links, hiring posts - add to doc and annotate. (Samir to help)
- Run 1-page config sketch for 4 GPU Dedicated pool with expected QPS and cost numbers (need current cloud GPU rates - ask pricing ops).
- Pull example metric deck from FastCloud pilot (obscure PII) -> Jordan/Hale reference.

Evergreen Health (brief)
- Regional health system, interest in private deployment + on-prem for PHI/security.
- DM: VP Eng / Head of Innovation (name TBD).
- Value props: private deployment, audit logs, long retention for observability, guaranteed SLAs.
- Outreach angle: compliance-first pilot, offer audit checklist + on-prem runbook (short).

Quick call script (outbound cold call)
- Intro (15s) Hi, I’m Anjali at Redwood Inference - we help platform teams run LLMs reliably with predictable latency and cost.
- Value (15s) We recently helped a regional healthcare org run a private inference deployment with KMS + audit logs in 6 weeks.
- Ask (15s) Any interest in a short chat to see if this is relevant?

Loose ideas to test on call
- Show model routing policy UI -> customers often respond to concrete visuals.
- Bring up cost-savings case study early if they push back on budget.
- Offer to map existing infra to Redwood in a 30m technical sync with their infra lead.

Notes to self / follow-ups
- Keep the first outbound to platform leads (Jordan) rather than application product leads.
- If no reply after 7 days: send a one-pager + invite to "platform office hours" demo (biweekly).
- Tag deck with metrics: tokens/sec, 90p latency, monthly token cost pre/post.

Rough handoffs
- If they ask for SAML/KMS detail, loop in security & compliance team (Confluence page CONFLUENCE-PLAT-1234).
- For pilot pricing: coordinate with pricing-ops and solutions-eng (ticket: JIRA-ACCT-879).

Unresolved questions:
- Who is the best internal champion at Acme? try DevRel or infra lead.
- Do they have in-house model tuning or are they using hosted third-party models? need to find out.

Scratch/phrases to reuse later:
- "predictable per-token economics"
- "routing policies that follow your product tiers"
- "can be live in 4-6 weeks with a small dedicated pool"

-- end --
